value.title: FIMfilm – Producer and director
value.main_text_excerpt:
FIMfilm’s most recent production is «John – the last cowboy»
Earlier is «The Wild Man of the North» and the two «Siblings are forever» films. The first is a slow and beautiful documentary, and winner of Best Feature at Big Sky Documentary Film Festival in Montana, USA. It is the most watched documentary of all time on TV 2.
The sequel «The Grand Journey» was released in cinemas the fall of 2015, and shown on Norwegian TV 2 in February 2016. For trailers and more information look here.
NRK and TV 2 have been primary clients for the last 15 years.
Look here for the complete filmography.
Director, producer and photographer Frode Fimland has worked in the Norwegian Film & Television industry for three decades. As a DOP he has worked on numerous wildlife and culture productions for the NRK worldwide.
